name: pagination
description: A source-owned shadcn-style Pagination composition with configurable native links.

documentation.compositionNote: Purely presentational nav (Pagination/PaginationContent/PaginationItem/PaginationLink/PaginationPrevious/PaginationNext/PaginationEllipsis), matching upstream's own non-interactive implementation -- links are plain anchors/buttons, page-change wiring is caller-composed.
documentation.accessibility: The root is `<nav role="navigation" aria-label="pagination">`; the active `PaginationLink` carries `aria-current="page"`; decorative previous/next glyphs are `aria-hidden` (`registry/ui/pagination.rs`).
documentation.keyboard: Links render as native anchors/buttons; Tab moves between them and Enter activates the focused one, with no additional roving-focus behavior of its own.
